Title: Flower Sort Adventure
Description: Step into a colorful world of blooming flowers! Match identical flowers, clear the shelves, and complete each level before time runs out. Build combos, collect stars, and use helpful boosters to overcome tricky challenges. How many levels can you beat?
Instructions:
- Tap matching flowers to bring them together.
- Match three identical flowers to clear them.
- Clear all the flowers before the timer runs out.
- Make consecutive matches to build combos and earn more stars.
- Use unlocked boosters when you need a helping hand

Title: Sticky Ball 64
Description: Roll your ball into anything smaller than it to stick it on and grow. Bigger things block you until you're big enough to pick them up. Reach the goal size before time runs out!
Instructions:
Roll your ball into anything smaller than it to stick it on and grow. Bigger things block you until you're big enough to pick them up. Reach the goal size before time runs out!

Desktop: W/S or Up/Down arrows to roll, A/D or Left/Right arrows to turn, Space to dash, Esc to pause.

Mobile: drag anywhere to roll and steer, tap DASH for a burst of speed.

Title: Stealth Shooter
Description:
Become a secret agent and clear dangerous levels without letting the guards raise the alarm. Move carefully, choose the right moment to act, and do not let enemies spot you too early.
Every mistake can turn the mission into a tense chase. Hide, aim better, complete challenges, and prove that you can act quietly, quickly, and under pressure.
Instructions:
The goal of the game: complete the level undetected, prevent the guards from raising the alarm, and complete the mission. Watch out for enemies, choose a safe moment to move, and avoid being spotted.

Controls: Aim with the mouse, aim and execute with the left mouse button. On a phone, use taps and swipes to aim and react quickly if a chase begins.

Title: Real Surgeon Simulator Game
Description: Step into the role of a skilled surgeon in Real Surgeon Simulator Games! Diagnose patients, perform surgeries, treat emergencies, and save lives across multiple hospital departments. Enjoy exciting offline gameplay, realistic medical tools, and challenging doctor missions.
Instructions:
- Tap: Select medical tools and interact with patients.
- Drag: Move medical instruments to the required treatment area.
- Follow On-Screen Prompts: Complete each medical procedure step by step.
- Tap Buttons: Select treatments, use medical equipment, and complete surgery tasks.
- Complete Objectives: Follow the instructions on the screen to treat patients and progress through the game.

Title: Block Masters
Description:
Block Master is a colorful and addictive puzzle game with a unique twist on classic match-3 gameplay!

Push blocks from the edges into the center of the board and match three or more blocks of the same color in a row or column to clear them. Every move matters, so think ahead, create clever combinations, and keep the board from filling up.

How long can you survive? Challenge yourself, beat your high score, and become the ultimate Block Master!
Instructions:
Tap any colored block along the outer edge to push it one space toward the center. A new block appears in the empty spot on the edge.

Tap the new block to push the blocks in that line further inward. Match 3 or more blocks of the same color horizontally or vertically to clear them.

Plan your moves carefully to avoid filling up the board. Keep matching blocks and survive as long as possible to achieve the highest score!

Title: Puppy Ranch: Pet Breeder
Description: Run your own puppy ranch! Catch wild dogs, breed adorable puppies, wash and care for them, and sell them to happy customers. Earn cash, buy bigger pet houses, hire a cashier and upgrade your ranch. Discover rare puppies to fill your collection book and grow from a tiny farm into the best pet breeder around.
Instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys (or drag with the mouse / touch to steer). Walk into dogs, pet houses and shops to interact. Click or tap buttons to open the upgrade shop and collection book.

Title: Obby: +1 Laser to Break Walls
Description: Shoot lasers to become stronger and destroy increasingly tougher walls! Every shot increases your Power, helping you break stronger walls and earn Wins. Spend your rewards on powerful new lasers and unlock unique auras with huge multipliers to speed up your progress. Keep upgrading your character, improve your damage, and push through new challenges. Enjoy satisfying wall-breaking action, bright visual effects, and simple controls.
Instructions: Desktop: Use WASD to move your character and hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera. Mobile: Use the on-screen joystick to move, tap the jump button to jump, and swipe to rotate the camera. Shoot lasers to gain Power, break walls to earn Wins, and unlock stronger lasers and auras.

Title: Mycelium
Description: Grow your fungus underground, cut off rival colonies and absorb them. A real-time territory strategy game, solo vs bots or online with friends.
Instructions:
Left-click: grow toward that spot or attack.
Right-click: abilities (Spore, Toxin).
Keys 1-9 and 0: how much biomass a click sends.
Q: Spore. E: Toxin.
Mouse wheel: zoom. Drag: move the map. Space: whole map.
Keep your land connected to your origin, or it withers!

Title: Bogatyrs
Description: Koschei has stolen the Firebird. Lead the bogatyrs of Rus across forests and swamps: drag from your terem to an enemy one and your squad marches off. Capture springs for mana, strike with runes, upgrade houses and outsmart bosses from Russian fairy tales: Solovey the Robber, Zmey Gorynych, Baba Yaga and Koschei himself. 91 levels for Rus, then a campaign for the Unclean.
Instructions: Drag from your building to a target to send a squad, or tap your building and then the target. Drag through several of your buildings to send them all. Double-tap your building to upgrade it. Tap a squad on the march to turn half of it home. Runes: tap the rune button, then a spot on the map. Keyboard: runes 1-4, troop share Q W E R, pause P or Esc.

Title: Ant Empire: Colony Clash
Description: Ant Empire: Colony Clash is a strategy game where you lead an ant colony to victory. Draw trails from your anthills to send marching ants, capture neutral nests and overrun rival colonies. Battle through 40 levels in five chapters: Backyard War, Picnic Kingdom, Lily Pond, Midnight Kitchen and Frozen Garden. Earn coins and stars, upgrade your Queen's hatch rate, march speed and starting army, and use Rally, Frenzy and Freeze boosters in tough boss levels.
Instructions: Press on one of your anthills and drag to another hill to draw a trail - your ants march along it on their own. Send ants to neutral or rival hills to capture them, or to your own hills to reinforce them. Tap a trail to stop it. Capture every hill on the map to win. Use boosters during a battle for an edge. Desktop: click and drag with the mouse. Mobile: drag with your finger.
